section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single cross-sectional study (Study X) with 256 undergraduate female students recruited from a large public university in the UAE. Participants were ethnically homogenous (all Arab descent, Muslim), aged 18-26 (M = 20.35), with self-reported BMI ranging from 14.27 to 49.42 kg/m² (M = 22.98). All participants had college-level education as they were enrolled as undergraduates.
